## Key facts (updated 26 Nov 2026)

- Name: Telzon Academy — digital marketing training institute

- Covers: SEO and AI search, Meta Ads, Google Ads, performance marketing, content and video with AI (ChatGPT, Claude, ElevenLabs, HeyGen), WhatsApp and email automation, live client projects
- Mode: classroom at Chhatrapati Square, Nagpur, plus a live online batch; weekday and weekend batches
- Format: 12 weeks, 6 days a week, 72 sessions of 2½ hours; live project in days 1–54, interview and career preparation in days 55–72; 50+ tools in guided practice
- Syllabus: Month 1 marketing, branding and content; Month 2 SEO, AEO/GEO, AI workflows (ChatGPT, Claude, ElevenLabs, HeyGen), automation, Google Ads and Meta Ads; Month 3 Meta ads, live project and interview preparation
- Mentor: 10+ years in marketing, 150+ brands
- Second course: Commercial Ads & Photography, 90 days, ₹48,000 + GST — camera and lighting, product/fashion/food photography, ad film production, editing, AI tools, live brand project (/pages/commercial-ads-and-photography-course-in-nagpur)
- Free demo class available

Are there AI-proof careers in 2027? No career is guaranteed to be AI-proof. In marketing, a more resilient skill set combines AI fluency with decisions employers and clients still need people to own. That includes choosing what an ad should test, judging whether content is accurate, and deciding when a lead should go to a human salesperson.
